opening.argument: The video reviews a receipt-scanning rewards app and shows how to scan a receipt, with gift cards presented as the benefit of collecting points. Its referral promotion is conditional: share a code, and two other participants must scan receipts for the stated points and gift-card reward. Those are ordinary app referral terms, not evidence of a deceptive transaction. The speaker also discloses a concern that receipt scanning may support targeted advertising. That concern does not, on its own, establish deception, financial loss, or a scam mechanism.

citations.quote: In this video I review the Fetch Rewards app.
You come in here You scan a receipt You pull up the camera
if you guys come into this and try this out and you share it with two friends and they both scan a receipt, you'll get 5,000 points. That's a $5 gift card.
